description: This file defines the SearchPageRoutes class which dynamically generates routing configurations for search pages within a Drupal module, including default, active, and help routes, with support for admin themes.

classes.name: SearchPageRoutes
classes.description: Provides dynamic routing for search pages in Drupal, implementing container injection, and generating routes for default, active, and help search pages, with admin theme support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchPageRoutes with a SearchPageRepositoryInterface instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate SearchPageRoutes with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Generates and returns an array of Route objects for search pages, including default, specific, and help routes, with admin theme options.
